request.description: 4.4-minute instrumental: 1990s TVB wuxia underscore style, section-only lyrics, supplied 2804-token ABC score, cot=full, seed 41, 32 midpoint steps

notes.same_request: All three engines ran the same style, lyrics, score, seed and step count. Each samples its own tokens (different RNG streams), so song lengths differ by a few percent; compare tok/s and stage times at the stated frame counts.
notes.token_weights: 8-bit affine group-64 AR for token generation; bf16 AR conditioning and NAR for flow matching; FP32 Oobleck VAE (YuE2-Vae) in all three.
notes.clocks: semantic = prefill + decode of semantic ids; nar = AR conditioning + 64 velocity evaluations; vae = tiled latent decode. yuwp-music and mlx-Yue end-to-end include model load from a warm page cache; mlx-serve end-to-end is one HTTP request against an already loaded model (SSE progress timestamps, includes returning the 50 MB WAV).
notes.parity: On mlx-Yue's own tokens and noise, yuwp-music latents match at 37.2 dB SNR (cosine 0.99990) and VAE audio at 124 dB. mlx-Yue itself documents a 0.054 latent RMS error against PyTorch.

yuwp_music_other_precisions.description: Short Mandarin song (two lyric sections), seed 7, 8 steps; semantic token generation only (8-bit run used cot=full, 4-bit and bf16 cot=melody)
